_comment: Corrections to published results, by Rullst version and implementation: metric prefixes to leave out and the reason shown with the results. Applied by bench/aggregate.py.

fastapi.problem: /db-single is not measured in this run: under load every request timed out because of a defect in this implementation (the session dependency's cleanup waited for a thread-pool slot held by requests waiting for a database connection), so the number says nothing about FastAPI. Fixed in Rullst/Benchmarks#8; the next run (Rullst 13.0.0-alpha.6) measures it again.
